name: Six selection permutations: exactly player plus other five captains
HUD has six distinct standings and /6 position count
Restart clears paused/countdown/race state and inputs
Pause freezes all six racers and race clock
Rank comparator orders finish times before progress
Player finish placement supports all six ranks
Same-step finishes are interpolated independently for all six racers
Tie at second place does not turn entire field into first-place ties
All fifteen boat pairs collide, including CPU versus CPU
Lapped boat contact uses physical track distance
Collision cooldowns are pair-local and cleared on restart
Six-way finish tie gives all six rank one
Five CPUs complete both laps and stay stopped while player remains racing
40 FPS fixture stays finite across full six-racer field
